name: Streaming LPM
definition: A technique to handle GPU memory limitations by splitting the volume into sub-volumes and slices, streaming them to the GPU, and processing one slice at a time. Radiance propagated through a slice is stored at the outgoing face and propagated through the next slice.
summary: Streaming LPM is a memory-management technique that renders high-resolution volumes on limited VRAM by processing small sub-volumes sequentially, decoupling memory footprint from total volume size.
